toolchain.why_this_toolchain: Exact frame counts and a reproducible same-material plain/proof pair isolate a brief relationship-density field, a frame-exact inset-to-full-canvas handoff and a long native release.

hook.reason: A close hand connection immediately establishes two people as one relationship unit.

setup.reason: The continuous contact clarifies the shared action before any compression.

buildup.reason: Distance, reconvergence and lift states accumulate inside the frame.

climax.reason: The lift becomes full-frame shared movement rather than remaining a small graphic state.

resolution.reason: The pair travel, pass close to camera, exit and leave the path moving.

cta.reason: This is a relationship-emotion grammar proof, not a response advertisement.

events.observation: Two people enter close to camera with one joined hand centered over the path while their bodies begin circling.
events.inference: The hand connection makes the relationship readable before the edit compresses later states.

narrative.function: establish the pair through physical contact

shot.subject: two people holding hands
shot.framing: wide two-shot with close hand center

cut.cut_reason: make the relationship anchor legible before density rises
cut.outgoing_motion: joined hands and circular body movement
cut.continuity: same pair, park axis and source take

transition.direction: close contact to wider relationship states

purpose.why_used: establish a physical bond before showing changes in distance and action ownership

events.observation: A live full-frame distance state appears first; reconvergence occupies the upper-left support window for 0.6 seconds, then clears exactly as the lower-right lift support window appears.
events.inference: Sequential support roles add open distance, renewed contact and changed action ownership without making two inset actions compete with the central pair at the same time.

narrative.function: compress three relationship states into a short progressive field

shot.subject: the same pair at distance, reconvergence and lift
shot.framing: full-frame moving base plus one support window at a time
shot.camera_angle: same park axis across one take
shot.camera_motion: native motion inside the base and active support window

cut.cut_reason: show multiple relationship-state changes before the physical release
cut.continuity: same pair, wardrobe, path, light and camera world

timing.rhythm: 0.6-second reconvergence support followed by a 1.6-second lift support and full-frame release

transition.transition_type: hard sequential support-window relay then full-frame handoff
transition.direction: distance base to reconvergence support to lift support to shared movement
transition.visual_anchor: pair silhouette, curved path and lift body hinge

purpose.when_used: after the contact anchor and before the long shared movement
purpose.applied_scene: full-frame distance with alternating reconvergence and lift support windows
purpose.why_used: make distance, renewed contact and action ownership readable without simultaneous inset competition

events.observation: The lift and carry continue full frame, the pair move close to camera, run together and clear the right edge while the path remains alive.
events.inference: The lower-right lift window continues on its next source frame at full size, converting compressed relationship states into embodied shared direction and a spatial afterimage.

narrative.function: release density into continuous shared movement and absence

shot.subject: two people lifting, carrying, running and fully exiting
shot.framing: lower-right live window continued as a full-frame wide two-shot, close pass and approximately 0.60-second empty path

cut.cut_reason: let the lift window become the main image and restore one readable physical trajectory after the dense relationship field
cut.incoming_motion: lift state in the lower-right live window
cut.outgoing_motion: the next native lift frame, shared exit and empty moving path
cut.continuity: same source take, pair, source frame sequence, action ownership and path axis

timing.rhythm: sustained exhale with a final spatial afterimage

transition.direction: lower-right lift window to the same lift action full frame
transition.visual_anchor: the exact next source frame of the pair's lift

motion.tracking: camera follows the shared run then settles on path
motion.easing: native body acceleration and camera settle

purpose.applied_scene: lift-window continuation, carry, run, full frame exit and approximately 0.60-second moving empty path
purpose.why_used: make the inset functional, turn relationship information into continuous shared direction and let the place retain the feeling after both people are gone
